studio.prompt: Empty warm fashion editorial background ONLY. Immaculate pale ivory and champagne photographic color field, quiet pale left half for dark editorial lettering. Soft restrained caramel glow at outer right edge, rich but understated warm neutrals. Frontal softbox light, smooth uninterrupted field, no floor, no pedestal, no horizon, no panel, no objects, no text, no handbag, no product, no logo.

environment.prompt: Empty sophisticated fashion gallery INTERIOR used as an editorial advertising background. Warm limestone walls, elegant tall architectural arch at far right, soft warm window light, one small olive plant and sculptural lounge chair restricted to far right third. Left two thirds contain a calm softly lit ivory wall, uncluttered. A rich credible interior with depth and material textures. No merchandise, no bags, no display products, no people, no labels, no logos, no readable signs. Camera approximately eye level. No table or pedestal in central foreground. The scene will be partly covered by a flat graphic advertisement panel, not used to fake an installed product.
